title: distro-aware preflight + automated registry seed for airgapped installs
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds a distro-aware preflight check and a registry seeding automation tool for airgapped/private installs. Includes Terraform variable for mirror ACLs, Helm chart toleration patch for airgapped nodes, and upgraded offline bundle generator with per-distro package manifests. Backwards compatible; improves preflight coverage and reduces manual registry bootstrap steps.
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR implements two tightly coupled features requested during several on-prem deployments: a distro-aware preflight verifier that surfaces kernel/container/runtime mismatches before attempting airgapped bootstrap, and an automated registry-seed workflow that consumes our OCI lockfile to atomically populate a local registry in offline environments. The goal is to reduce time-to-ready for customers running private installs (VPC/on-prem) and to eliminate a common source of bootstrap flakes in our installer.

Summary of changes (single string):
- New preflight binary (installer/preflight/distro_check.go + scripts) that reads a 'distro-manifest' (bundles/metadata/distros/*) and verifies: kernel version ranges, required kernel modules (ip_vs, overlay, br_netfilter), containerd/cri-o versions, required sysctl settings, and suitable storage drivers. The preflight outputs a machine-readable JSON report and an optional human-friendly markdown summary.
- Registry seeder (installer/seed/oci_seed.py and seed/terraform-module) that: parses our OCI lockfile, generates a seeding plan respecting image order and tag aliases, streams blobs to a local registry with checksum verification and resumable upload, and writes a registry-index file used by the installer to avoid runtime network lookups. Supports delta-seed where only missing blobs are pushed.
- Terraform: adds a mirror module variable and ACL helper (terraform/modules/registry-mirror) so customers can provision a pre-seed bucket/registry with minimal IAM changes; includes example usage in quickstarts/terraform/airgap-mirror.tf.
- Helm chart patch: charts/redwood-installer/values-airgap.yaml and a small Helm hook to apply nodeSelector/tolerations for nodes designated as 'airgapped' to ensure control-plane pods schedule correctly on constrained nodes.
- Offline bundle generator: updates to bundle tool (tools/bundle-gen) to emit per-distro package manifests (deb/rpm/bz) and a light-weight delta index to support smaller seed images.
- Tests: integration tests in test/airgap_seed_test.sh and unit tests for distro parsing.

Commit summary: see commits list below.

Changed areas (high level):
- installer/preflight/* (new)
- installer/seed/* (new)
- terraform/modules/registry-mirror/* (modified + new examples)
- charts/redwood-installer/* (airgap values + hook)
- tools/bundle-gen/* (updates)
- test/* (integration + unit)

Review conversation (high level and actions):
- Ethan: asked for clearer failure categories in preflight (fatal vs warning). Addressed by adding structured 'severity' field to JSON output and updating docs.
- Sofia: requested resumable uploads and idempotency for the seeder. Implemented chunked uploads with resume token stored in registry-index; added tests for interrupted push.
- Jacob: pointed out potential permission explosion in Terraform example. Tightened IAM snippet and added explicit least-privilege comments.
- CI: initial lint failure on shellcheck and go vet — fixed by tightening quoting and adding context to error returns.

CI summary:
- Unit tests: pass
- Integration (seed simulation): pass (runs against local containerd registry simulator)
- Lint: pass after fixes

Merge outcome: merged via squash. This PR will be followed by a docs PR to add a 'preflight' troubleshooting guide and an operations runbook for manual registry seeding (links in release notes).

Notes for operators:
- The preflight can be run independently: ./installer/preflight/check --bundle ./bundles/<name>.tar.gz --out preflight-report.json
- The registry seeder accepts --resume-token to continue interrupted pushes. Seed generates a registry-index.json that the installer can consume via --registry-index.
- Terraform module exposes 'mirror_allowed_cidrs' and 'mirror_service_principal' for cloud mirrors.

Backwards compatibility and rollout plan:
- The new tools are additive. Installer will fallback to existing network fetch behavior if no registry-index is provided. We'll ship the docs and a quickstart to customers running Private in the next week.
